posteriores.texto: Pasur, filho de Imer, o sacerdote, que era o oficial-chefe na casa do SENHOR, ouviu Jeremias profetizar estas palavras.
Pasur bateu no profeta Jeremias e o colocou no tronco que ficava na porta superior de Benjamim, a qual ficava na casa do SENHOR.

kjv.texto: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
